chunks: From coming after me? Did you not disobey my command?" (And Moses pulled him by the hair).

key_terms.أَلَا: Interrogative particle indicating surprise or reproach

ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to Al-Khidr when he questioned his actions?
ai.summary: This verse captures the moment of reproach where Prophet Moses (AS) questions Al-Khidr for acting against his explicit command, highlighting the tension between prophetic expectation and hidden divine wisdom. In Shia exegesis, this dialogue illustrates the concept of *batin* (inner meaning) versus *zahir* (outer appearance), showing that apparent disobedience may conceal a higher, unseen decree. The phrase serves as a reminder that human knowledge is limited compared to the comprehensive wisdom of Allah.
